20.en:
Ability Controls:
Click = Right-Click / LT / Tap Screen
Punch = Left-Click / RT / Tap Screen/block/entity
When it says 'jump or sneak' and click, make sure
that you HOLD the button and then press click.

This Addon is not recommended to play with more than 5-6 people due to delay/lag
This addon will not function well on realms.









技能操作说明:
点击(Click) = 右键 / LT / 点按屏幕
拳击(Punch) = 左键 / RT / 点按屏幕/方块/实体
当提示“跳跃或潜行 + 点击”时，请务必
先按住该按钮，然后再按下点击键。

由于延迟/卡顿，本插件不建议超过 5-6 人同时游玩
本插件在 Realms 领域服上无法良好运行。

160.en:
§r§f< §o§f§lThe Architect §r§f> §fThis place? Oh well, when SOMEONE decided to mess with my console, you seemed to have overloaded it with fragments of my creations from past times, basically sucking you and a bunch of random stuff info this pocket dimension.
However when the console tried to divert excess energy to my home reality, it accidently brought in creations from there too, which is how I'm assuming you managed to find my Containment System and release... him.

As for the reason why your abilities do not work here, well thats most likely because it's been corrupted, the only powers that work here are powers that were brought through the rifts, which is why you obtained random abilities that you used to your advantage to take him down.
160.zh:
§r§f< §o§f§l造物主 §r§f> §f这个地方？唉，都怪「某个人」乱动我的控制台，你似乎让它超载了——我过去的造物碎片被灌了进去，结果把你和一堆乱七八糟的东西一起吸进了这个口袋维度。
不过当控制台试图把多余能量导回我所在的现实时，也意外带进了那边的造物——我猜你就是这样找到了我的收容系统，并放出了……他。

至于你的能力为什么在这里失效，多半是因为它们已经被腐化了。在这里唯一能生效的，就是从裂隙中带进来的力量。这也是为什么你获得了那些随机能力，并利用它们击败了他。

161.en:
§r§f< §o§f§lThe Architect §r§f> §fAh, you want to know what that was? He's a living entity I created imbued with fragments of my past self, he's not really fun to be around and would always try causing chaos or being egotistical because he thought he was better than everyone, he never knew he was a creation, he seems to think he's actually alive and has a grudge against me for banishing him after he caused too much drama and gave the name Heroic a bad reputation. He's basically just an alternate version of me I created, using abilities I had created and summoning echoes of my friends and creations... all while corrupting them.
You're lucky he wasn't capable of summoning the true potential of those echoes, if they had really been here you would've stood no chance as some of them are just as powerful as me...
161.zh:
§r§f< §o§f§l造物主 §r§f> §f啊，你想知道那是什么？他是我创造的一个活体，体内灌注了我过去自我的碎片。他一点都不好相处，总想惹是生非、自命不凡，因为他觉得自己比谁都强。他从不知道自己是被创造出来的，还真以为自己是活着的；他惹出太多乱子、败坏了 Heroic 这个名字，所以我把他放逐了，他因此怀恨在心。他基本上就是我创造出的「另一个我」，使用我创造的能力，召唤我朋友和造物的回响……并将它们全部腐化。
你应该庆幸他召唤不出那些回响真正的潜力——如果它们本体真的来了，你毫无胜算，因为其中一些和我一样强……

162.en:
§r§f< §o§f§lThe Architect §r§f> §fAh, you want to know what that was? He's a living entity I created imbued with fragments of my past self, he's not really fun to be around and would always try causing chaos or being egotistical because he thought he was better than everyone, he never knew he was a creation, he seems to think he's actually alive and has a grudge against me for banishing him after he caused too much drama and gave the name Heroic a bad reputation. He's basically just an alternate version of me, using abilities I had created and summoning friends of mine all while corrupting them.
You're lucky he wasn't capable of summoning the true potential of those echoes, if they had really been here you would've stood no chance as some of them are just as powerful as me...


 I know he's not evil to the core, after all he is me. He's just misunderstood and corrupted, which is why I sealed him away forever. But he doesn't realise it's for our own good.
162.zh:
§r§f< §o§f§l造物主 §r§f> §f啊，你想知道那是什么？他是我创造的一个活体，体内灌注了我过去自我的碎片。他一点都不好相处，总想惹是生非、自命不凡，因为他觉得自己比谁都强。他从不知道自己是被创造出来的，还真以为自己是活着的；他惹出太多乱子、败坏了 Heroic 这个名字，所以我把他放逐了，他因此怀恨在心。他基本上就是我的另一个版本，使用我创造的能力，召唤我的朋友们的虚影……并将它们全部腐化。
你应该庆幸他没能召唤出那些回响真正的潜力——如果它们本体真的来了，你毫无胜算，因为其中一些和我一样强……


 我知道他并非坏到骨子里，毕竟他就是我。他只是被误解又被腐化了，所以我才将他永远封印。但他不明白，这是为了我们大家好。

163.en:
§r§f< §o§f§lThe Architect §r§f> §fMy console? I have one in every reality where my authority reaches to control the flow of things, they're usually hidden pretty well but sometimes they can be unstable and allow things to leak into their reality.
Sometimes entities in that reality mess with it, taking components, worshipping it, creating artifacts and a ton of other nonsense allowing situations like this to happen.
Trust me you're not the first one I've talked to, this has happened several times before, it's kind of a nuisance at this point, however this time things were different as you somehow managed to break him out.
163.zh:
§r§f< §o§f§l造物主 §r§f> §f我的控制台？在每一个我权限所及的现实里我都放了一台，用来控制事物的流转。它们通常藏得很好，但有时会不稳定，让东西泄漏进那个现实。
有时那个现实里的家伙会乱动它——拆零件、膜拜它、制造圣物，干出一大堆蠢事，导致现在这种情况发生。
相信我，你不是第一个跟我聊这事的人，这种事以前发生过好几次，到现在都挺烦人了。不过这次不一样——你居然真的把他放出来了。

164.en: §r§f< §o§f§lThe Architect §r§f> §fYou want to know about me? What's so important about me? I'm not even here, I'm sitting at home being lazy right now, you're just talking to another projection of me I put into this world. But other than that I'm the guy who created this all... ok well I don't create the realities but I'm responsible for the modifications added to all these realities or 'worlds'. In other words, Im similar to you, a player. You have the ability to do the same things I do if you try hard enough.
164.zh: §r§f< §o§f§l造物主 §r§f> §f你想了解我？我有什么可重要的？我本人根本不在这儿——我正宅在家里摸鱼呢，你现在只是在跟我放进这个世界的另一个投影说话。除此之外，我是创造这一切的人……好吧，现实本身不是我创造的，但所有这些现实（或者说「世界」）里加入的修改都是我负责的。换句话说，我和你很像，也是个玩家。只要足够努力，你也能做到我做的这些事。

165.en:
§r§f< §o§f§lThe Architect §r§f> §fWhy did I take so long to arrive? I just cba...

Besides I get this sort of thing pretty often, when I'm creating such strong beings I often overlook how powerful I can really make them, sometimes they go out of control, atleast for other players to handle. Take astaroth for example, he originated from the island, however he managed to break through into another reality of mine, Meridia and caused chaos there.

Thankfully I had made the power system of that reality stronger than his prior reality, allowing even the weakest spells to cause harm to him, I eventually sealed him away but he managed to break through into this reality somehow, I'm not sure what or who freed him but I believe it may have been another one of my creations' influence, or worse, another player/creator... If that is the case, that means there's someone out there who could be a threat to me and my creations... I did feel a disturbance of some sort when you disrupted those rifts that artifact lead you to.
165.zh:
§r§f< §o§f§l造物主 §r§f> §f为什么我这么久才来？我就是懒得动……

再说这种事经常发生。我创造的生物太强时，我常常低估自己能让他们强到什么程度，有时他们就会失控——至少对其他玩家来说难以应付。就拿 Astaroth 来说吧，他起源于那座岛，却突破进入了我另一个现实 Meridia，在那里大闹了一场。

好在那个现实的力量体系比他原本的更强大，连最弱的法术都能伤到他，我最终把他封印了。但不知怎的，他又突破到了这个现实。我不确定是什么或是谁释放了他——我猜可能是我另一个造物的影响，或者更糟……是另一个玩家/创作者。如果是后者，那就意味着外面有个能威胁到我和我的造物的家伙……你扰乱那件圣物指引你找到的那些裂隙时，我确实感觉到了某种扰动。

166.en:
§r§f< §o§f§lThe Architect §r§f> §fOh right, you did do my chores for me I guess, even after causing this mess.
Fine... I guess I can give you a little something to make up for your efforts.

Here take this object, It's imbued with several creations of mine from the past and present, it should be useful, it'll be random whichever one you get though.

好吧……看在你出了力的份上，我就给你点小东西作为补偿吧。

拿着这个。它灌注了我过去与现在的几件造物，应该会有用——不过你抽到哪一件是随机的哦。

1038.en:
§r§fYou now have §l§7-[Common]- Immobilizing Sight Technique...
§r§g- §r§gYour eyes are imbued with cursed energy, sneaking and staring at anyone will freeze them in place making them unable to move or attack, be careful as over-using your eyes can lead to danger.
1038.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§7-[普通]- 凝视定身术式……
§r§g- §r§g你的双眼注入了咒力，潜行并盯着任何人都会将其冻结在原地，使其无法移动或攻击。要小心，过度使用眼睛会带来危险。

1039.en:
§r§fYou now have §l§7-[Common]- Miracles Technique...
§r§g- This technique erases most little miracles from your life and stores them, which is shown by the marks under your eyes. These stored miracles are released when your life is in danger, altering your luck to ensure you survive or evade would-be fatal blows. When a miracle has been used, the marking turns to white.§r§g.
1039.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§7-[普通]- 奇迹术式……
§r§g- 该术式会抹除你生活中大多数的小奇迹并将其储存，储存量显示为你眼下的印记。这些储存的奇迹会在你生命垂危时释放，改变你的运气，确保你得以幸存或避开致命一击。每当一个奇迹被消耗，印记就会变白。§r§g。

1040.en:
§r§fYou now have §l§2-[Uncommon]- Explosive Cursed Energy...
§r§g- §r§fManifested by pure cursed energy power, you control Cursed Energy in its purest form creating devastating explosions.
1040.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§2-[优秀]- 爆发咒力……
§r§g- §r§f由纯粹的咒力显现，你操控最纯粹形态的咒力，制造毁灭性的爆炸。

1041.en:
§r§fYou now have §l§2-[Uncommon]- Wind-Up Technique...
§r§g- §r§gWind-up your arm in order to store strength overtime that stacks allowing you to release it all at once in a devastating blow.
1041.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§2-[优秀]- 蓄能术式……
§r§g- §r§g蓄力摆动手臂，随时间积攒并叠加力量，让你能够一次性将其全部释放，打出毁灭性的一击。

1042.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§3§o-[Rare]- Cursed Speech Technique...
§r§g- Passed down by the Inumaki Clan, this technique reinforces your words with cursed energy, forcing targets to do what the user says, however it has large drawbacks if abused.
1042.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§3§o-[稀有]- 咒言术式……
§r§g- 狗卷世家世代相传的术式，用咒力增幅你的言语，强迫目标按你所说的行动，但滥用会有严重的副作用。

1043.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§3§o-[Rare]- Absorption Technique...
§r§g- Allows you to store damage to your body and convert it into kinetic energy, releasing powerful electric bursts.
1043.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§3§o-[稀有]- 吸收术式……
§r§g- 让你将身体受到的伤害储存起来并转化为动能，释放出强力的电击爆发。

1044.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§3§o-[Rare]- Boogie-Woogie Technique...
§r§g- We are the Exception! You can swap the places of 2 Objects that have cursed energy, including living beings.
1044.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§3§o-[稀有]- 不义游戏术式……
§r§g- 我们是例外者！你可以交换两个拥有咒力的物体的位置，包括生物在内。

1045.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§5-[Exotic]- Judgeman Technique...
§r§g- §r§fA genius technique, the pinnacle of jujutsu sorcery. You control the Judgeman shikigami which allows you to pass judgement on those who have sinned.
1045.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§5-[传说]- 审判者术式……
§r§g- §r§f天才般的术式，咒术的巅峰之作。你可以操控审判者式神，对有罪之人下达裁决。

1046.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§5-[Exotic]- Private Pure Lovetrain Technique...
§r§g- §r§fThe Personal technique created by Hakari Kinji, allows you to manipulate and form objects related to gambling and bring forth your domain to test your luck, rolling triple 6 or 7 will allow you to enter a state of unlimited cursed energy, granting you immortality and immense power for 4 minutes and 11 seconds.
1046.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§5-[传说]- 坐杀博徒术式……
§r§g- §r§f由秤金次独创的个人术式，让你能够操纵并生成与赌博相关的物体，并展开领域来测试你的运气。掷出三同 6 或 7 即可进入无限咒力的状态，在 4 分 11 秒内获得不死之身与强大的力量。

1047.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§b§o-[Honored]- Limitless Technique...
§r§g- Passed down by the Gojo Clan, this technique can manipulate space and infinity to destroy anything in your path and with the Six Eyes it holds limitless potential
1047.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§b§o-[天选]- 无下限术式……
§r§g- 五条世家世代相传的术式，能够操纵空间与无限，摧毁挡在你面前的一切。配合六眼，它有着不可限量的潜力。

1048.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§b§o-[Honored]- 10 Shadows Technique...
§r§g- Passed down by the Zenin Clan, this technique gives you control over 10 Different Shadows including the infamous Mahoraga. (Btw you start with everything untamed, yes ik thats not canon but shush)
1048.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§b§o-[天选]- 十种影法术……
§r§g- 禅院世家世代相传的术式，让你能够驱使 10 种不同的影子式神，包括大名鼎鼎的魔虚罗。（顺带一提，开局时全部式神都是未驯服状态——我知道这不符合原作设定，但别较真）

1049.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§b§o-[Honored]- Mythical Beast Amber+Electrified Cursed Energy...
§r§g- Your Cursed Energy has taken an insanely rare form of being Electrified, you now have the power of using lightning fast attacks of electricity along with the infamous Mythical Beast Amber trump card, used by Kashimo.
1049.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§b§o-[天选]- 幻兽琥珀+带电荷咒力……
§r§g- 你的咒力呈现出极其罕见的带电形态，你现在能够以快如闪电的电击发动攻击，并握有鹿紫云一使用过的王牌——幻兽琥珀。

1050.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§c§o-[Dishonored]- Disaster Flames Technique...
§r§gBrought to humanity and fueled by their fear of fire and volcanoes, this Cursed Technique allows you to control flames, volcanic eruptions, meteors, lava and destroy your enemies.
1050.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§c§o-[恶名]- 灾厄烈焰术式……
§r§g由人类对火焰与火山的恐惧孕育而成的术式，让你能够操控烈焰、火山喷发、陨石与熔岩，将敌人尽数毁灭。

1051.en:
§r§fYou now have the §l§c§o-[Dishonored]- Idle Transfiguration Technique...
§r§gBrought to humanity and fueled by the fear of their own kind, this Cursed Technique allows you to manipulate and transfigure the souls of humans, aswell as your own.
1051.zh:
§r§f你现在拥有 §l§c§o-[恶名]- 无为转变术式……
§r§g由人类对同类的恐惧孕育而成的术式，让你能够操纵并改造人类的灵魂——包括你自己的。

§5The Omega-Death Scythe, a relic of unfathomable destruction,
forged by the Architect as a shadow of something far greater.
Though merely an echo of Nacker’s true creation,
its power is anything but diminished—each swing carries the weight of oblivion itself,
severing fate and existence in an instant. A weapon forgotten across realities,
its presence alone warps the fabric of creation, leaving only devastation in its wake.

§eNote: §5(Originating From Craftwars, if you are wondering why there are so many craftwars related items,
well craftwars was a big game in my childhood
and one of the things I used to make maps/worlds on all the time, I often like to recreate things I find cool but inside minecraft...
And NO, the rainbow has nothing to do with lgbt or whatever,
its solely based on what the ORIGINAL looked like, get out)'

§5究极死亡之镰，一件拥有无法想象的毁灭之力的遗物，
由造物主锻造，作为某个更伟大存在的投影。
尽管它只是 Nacker 真正杰作的回响，
其威力却丝毫不减——每一次挥舞都承载着湮灭本身的重量，
在瞬间斩断命运与存在。一件被诸多现实遗忘的武器，
仅凭其存在就足以扭曲造物的结构，所过之处只剩毁灭。

§e注: §5(出自 Craftwars。如果你好奇为什么有这么多 Craftwars 相关的物品——
它是我童年时很重要的一款游戏，我过去总是在上面制作地图/世界，我常常喜欢把觉得酷的东西在 Minecraft 中重现……
另外，那个彩虹跟 LGBT 之类的没有任何关系，
它纯粹是基于原作本来的样子，走开啦)'
